card.name: Citations and statistics in child-psychology text
card.fires_on: Spaces, punctuation and name pieces inside reference lists and statistic sentences about children, teens and suicide. It fires just before a number or author name.

modes.label: Before numbers in statistics
modes.description: The space before a figure in a sentence about youth suicide rates or ages.
modes.example: In 1996, suicide was the 3rd leading cause of death in<< >>15 to 24 year olds

modes.label: Inside reference entries
modes.description: Author names, volume or page separators in citations on parenting and child therapy.
modes.example: Eyberg, S .M., Funderburk, B. W., Hembree-Kigin, T., Mc<<Neil>>, C. B., Querido

modes.label: Crisis line mention
modes.description: The word Suicide in a hotline name.
modes.example: call the National<< Suicide>> and Crisis Lifeline at 98

card.writes: It lowers alcohol and substance-abuse words, so it steers the output away from addiction topics.
card.plain: It marks citation and statistics text about child and teen mental health, and it pushes away from alcohol and drug words.
